business_problem: smart Europe needed to automate case handling in its customer engagement center because Salesforce-based workflows were manual, inconsistent and too slow for its direct-to-consumer sales and after-sales model.
solution_summary: smart Europe, IBM Consulting and IBM Client Engineering built a generative-AI customer-service MVP inside Salesforce. IBM watsonx.ai runs on IBM Cloud and processes incoming tickets before any human action, automatically summarizing, categorizing and prioritizing cases. IBM Watson Discovery resolves standard queries directly so answers remain consistent and on brand, while a Salesforce UI component shows agents the system-generated decisions and recommended next steps. The design converts customer inquiries into structured support actions early in the lifecycle, reducing manual triage and improving routing quality. Because the solution is compatible with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Adobe and additional use cases, it can be scaled beyond the first deployment into other regions and departments. The architecture therefore improves the immediate customer-service workflow while also creating a reusable automation pattern for smart Europe’s broader D2C operating model.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Automates summarization, categorization and prioritization of incoming customer cases.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Answers standard customer queries automatically and provides consistent knowledge retrieval.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Hosts the customer-case workflow and the UI component that surfaces AI-generated decisions to agents.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the runtime environment for the ticket-processing solution.

data_flow: Customer cases enter Salesforce, are processed by watsonx.ai for summary and prioritization, routed to Watson Discovery for standard-question resolution where possible, and then returned to agents through a Salesforce UI for follow-up.
business_outcome: smart Europe improved case accuracy and resolution speed while making it easier for agents to deliver personalized support as online vehicle sales interactions increased.
